rca of the issue: PreventivoInfissi /new 404 bug: useParams returns 'new' as the id value when URL is /preventivoinfissi/new. The component used `isNew = !id` which evaluates false for the truthy string 'new', causing api.get('/preventivi/new') to fire and 404. Mitigation: changed to `isNew = !id || id === 'new'`. Verified by reload — page now renders form, ante selector works, abaco SVG draws dividers and numbered circles correctly for 2/3/4 ante.
